definition: Arterial blood gas testing measures properties such as blood pH and oxygen and carbon dioxide partial pressures in an arterial sample to assess respiratory and acid-base status.
entry_text: Arterial blood gas testing measures properties such as blood pH and oxygen and carbon dioxide partial pressures in an arterial sample to assess respiratory and acid-base status.
example: A clinician reviews the test after a change in ventilation to assess carbon dioxide clearance.
label: Arterial blood gas testing
